The diode-connected inverter load gives a resistive 1/(gmn+gmp) load with gain ≈ sqrt-ratio, so the stage is fairly linear and swing is good. It also self-biases vout at its trip point (~0.8 V) without precision current matching. Budget: Imain≈470 µA + Iload≈150 µA + Iref, about 1.15 mW."}

PARAMS = {
    "Imain": (470e-6, 250e-6, 600e-6),   # main inverter current (n = p at vin=0.75)
    "Iload": (150e-6, 60e-6, 300e-6),    # diode-connected load-inverter current
    "vo":    (0.80, 0.68, 1.00),         # target output DC = load-inverter trip point
    "Ln":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.30),         # main NMOS L
    "Lp":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.30),         # main PMOS L
    "Ll":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.30),         # load-inverter L (both devices)
}

def _wsolve(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, Id):
    # find W giving Id at a fixed bias (vgs is pinned by vin_dc / vout target)
    W = 10.0
    for _ in range(6):
        o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)
        W = min(max(W * Id / max(o["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 4000.0)
    o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)
    gmid = min(max(o["gm_id"], 3.0), 24.0)
    d = lut.size(dev, gmid, L, o["Id"], vds=vds)   # for parasitic caps (cdd)
    return W, o, d

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)
    vo = p["vo"]

    # main inverter: both devices driven by vin, balanced at vout = vo
    Wn1, n1, d_n1 = _wsolve(lut, "n", p["Ln"], vin, vo, p["Imain"])
    Wp1, p1, d_p1 = _wsolve(lut, "p", p["Lp"], vdd - vin, vdd - vo, p["Imain"])
    # load inverter: gate = drain = vout, balanced at vo
    Wn2, n2, d_n2 = _wsolve(lut, "n", p["Ll"], vo, vo, p["Iload"])
    Wp2, p2, d_p2 = _wsolve(lut, "p", p["Ll"], vdd - vo, vdd - vo, p["Iload"])
    # ibias sink: diode-connected nfet (gives IREF a DC path)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn1, p["Ln"])
    n.M("M2", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp1, p["Lp"])
    n.M("M3", "vout", "vout", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn2, p["Ll"])
    n.M("M4", "vout", "vout", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, p["Ll"])
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    gm1 = n1["gm"] + p1["gm"]
    g_out = n2["gm"] + p2["gm"] + n1["gds"] + p1["gds"] + n2["gds"] + p2["gds"]
    c_out = (cl + d_n1.cdd + d_p1.cdd
             + n2["cgg"] + p2["cgg"] + d_n2.cdd + d_p2.cdd)
    gain = gm1 / g_out
    f3db = g_out / (2 * PI * c_out)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * c_out)
    i_tot = 0.5 * (n1["Id"] + p1["Id"]) + 0.5 * (n2["Id"] + p2["Id"]) + iref
    power = vdd * i_tot
    # matched inverter pair ~ linear transfer; usable range limited by ~0.25 V from each rail
    swing = min(2 * 0.3 * gain, (vdd - 0.3) - 0.25)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": swing,
    }
